result_text:
I fixed the four typos in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The existing `*Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests or check the new patterns against sample files.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, which listed `html` twice. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too.
- **`.js` and `.xml` generated code:** the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule and the .NET `<doc>` XML rule used `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml`, which only match a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`, so `app.js` and `MyAssembly.xml` match.
- **Gradle scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The content patterns are unchanged. A hand-written `.htm`, `.js` or `.xml` file still needs the matching first-lines content (the generator comment, tag or `<doc>` line) to land in a generated scope.

I didn't commit anything.
